protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: How a room connects, how peers encrypt and recover messages, and how the signaling host validates native testnet transfers.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: What you can use today, what the local timing and ledger tests measured, and what it will take to run an independently verified testnet.

whitepaper.title: P2PARTY whitepaper
whitepaper.description: How a payer can buy a route through several relays, how validators agree on transfer order, and what a wallet can prove. A draft for review before mainnet.

wallet.title: P2PARTY wallet
wallet.description: To spend or restore a testnet unit, bring its signing key and matching receive nonce. To receive a unit, share a fresh public payment descriptor.
